honest_limits: ELITISM-ARTIFACT is PARTIAL, not a freeze refutation: unaided MAP-Elites archives hold verify>0 elites (max 0.248046875, root 7) that single-fitness champion search discarded every generation — the zero-signal claim fails. But no config on any root crosses the 0.45 bar without skeleton birth: the CROSSING claim is selection-regime-invariant.

Illumination moves the unaided ceiling 0 -> 0.248 (Finding-4 partial-plateau class); seeding moves it 0.248 -> 0.482421875. Selection-regime-invariance holds for the crossing claim, fails for the zero-signal claim.
Archive-elite transplant (config c, least-visited-cell injection every 4 gens) is NOT a third crossing class: 0/3 roots crossed; r7 reached 0.4355 — below the 0.45 bar, named rather than rounded.

Descriptor-honesty caveat: verify balance is a DESCRIPTOR in both archives (selection never sees the held-out seed 202); elites with verify>0 were promoted on train fitness alone, so their verify values are not selection bias — but they are also single-seed (verify 202) measurements, not replicated per-root in this design.
Results-style receipt (no witness LEDGER; exp001 remains the lane's only LEDGER receipt): sealed artifacts are the runner + results.json + telemetry jsonl, sha256-pinned.
